jobs.title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

What You'll Do

Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

Who You Are

You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know – we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Spotify transformed music listening forever when we launched in 2008. Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Enterprise Systems
jobs.description:
This hybrid role requires working in the office two days per week.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About The Role

The Enterprise Systems Team sits within the Technology Operations organization and partners with finance, business, analytics, product and engineering stakeholders to help build and deliver projects to increase business efficiency and automate global teams’ business processes. This individual will contribute to the design, development, and delivery of great business-facing products, system enhancements and critical reporting to finance and business stakeholders.

In This Role, You Will

Work closely with the business and product teams to lead cross-product improvements and initiatives.
Write code to implement new tools and platforms, and maintain existing ones
Review and update existing integrations
Drive architecture evaluations and decisions to build reliable and observable systems
Build rapport with stakeholders, manage expectations and deadlines by providing guidance
Mentor and manage a team to effectively align resources with priorities and oversee quality of work and ongoing operational support being delivered to the finance stakeholders.

Please Apply If You Have

Bachelor’s Degree, preferably with an engineering/technical background.
Minimum of 10+ years of experience writing code, with a minimum of 5+ years on a fintech/enterprise technology team.
Strong demonstrable experience deploying JS/TS, PHP code in an enterprise environment
Strong demonstrable experience with SQL
Technical skills with prior hands-on experience developing and integrating financial systems such as ERP, AP Automation, AR Receivables, Travel and Expense, Enterprise O2C, R2R, P2P integration platforms
Critical thinking and strong analytical skills to provide guidance to your team with a great attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, adherence to data governance and control requirements.
Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams whether engineering, product, finance and business stakeholders.
Eagerness to constantly learn and grow in the role while adapting to whatever new systems are needed in the future.
Hands on experience with NetSuite, Softco, Expensify, Salesforce, payments etc. a plus.

Benefits And Perks

Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
Focus on mental health and well-being:
Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
Company-paid subscription to Headspace
Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

Paid parental leave
Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
Paid volunteer time
Focus on your career growth:
Development Dollars
Leadership development
Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

Travel Discounts
Employee Resource Groups
Free lunch 5 days per week
Beautiful office in the Empire State Building with lots of building amenities, such as a gym, multi-purpose room, in-building Starbucks, and more.

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States based role is $190,000-$220,000.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus and equity grant.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

jobs.description:
Locations: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Detroit, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, Hoboken, Philadelphia, San Francisco, Seattle

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The Opportunity

EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.

With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.

Within EY-Parthenon, the Growth Platforms team focuses on building durable technology and AI capabilities that power longterm enterprise growth. The Software Engineering Director for AI Tooling plays a pivotal role in translating strategy into execution—designing and scaling modern software platforms, AIenabled tools, and internal products that create measurable value for Fortune 500 and growthstage clients alike.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering excellence, applied AI, and business impact—partnering closely with executives, product leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to deliver systems that can be adopted, trusted, and scaled.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Software Engineering Director, you will lead the design and delivery of productiongrade software systems and AIenabled tooling that underpin highvisibility client engagements and internal platforms. You will own architectural decisions, development standards, and technical direction across multiple workstreams.

Key responsibilities include:

Architect, build, and scale core software platforms that integrate data, AI services, and userfacing applications.
Lead the development of AIpowered tools, including decision support systems, copilots, internal developer tools, and domainspecific agents.
Design and maintain robust service architectures (APIs, eventdriven systems, batch and realtime pipelines) optimized for reliability, security, and extensibility.
Establish engineering best practices across code quality, testing, CI/CD, observability, and performance.
Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to productionize models and agents, ensuring seamless integration into realworld workflows.
Partner directly with business leaders and Csuite executives to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions.
Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Successful candidates will bring strong engineering judgment, fluency in modern AI tooling, and the ability to operate comfortably across strategy and execution.

You will be expected to:

Lead development of backend and fullstack systems using modern languages and frameworks (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, TypeScript).
Design and manage cloudnative architectures on platforms such as AWS or GCP, using containerization and infrastructureascode.
Build AIready application layers that integrate LLMs, retrieval systems, vector databases, and model orchestration frameworks.
Develop internal tooling and developer platforms that improve velocity, reliability, and reuse across teams.
Define and enforce standards for security, privacy, reliability, and compliance (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, enterprise governance).
Translate ambiguous business problems into concrete system designs and incremental delivery plans.
Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.

To qualify for the role, you must have

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and 5+ years of professional engineering experience; or A graduate degree and approximately 3+ years of relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience in senior software engineering, platform engineering, or technical leadership roles.
Strong proficiency in modern software development practices, including APIs, distributed systems, and cloud services.
Hands on experience deploying AIenabled applications or tooling into production environments.
Comfort operating in fastpaced, clientfacing environments with evolving requirements.
You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you will have

Experience working in management consulting, productled organizations, or highgrowth startups.
Familiarity with modern AI ecosystems, including LLM frameworks, agent architectures, and prompt/tool orchestration.
A strong product mindset—understanding not just how to build systems, but how they will be adopted and sustained.
Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.

What we look for

We are looking for candidates who have a strong aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance. Being a strong team player is critical with the ability to adapt to changing requirements or deadlines in support of our clients’ goals.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $205,000 to $235,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Job Profile

Technology Architect for Intraday Liquidity / Cash Management, Director – New York (Hybrid)

Overview of Citi
:

Citi is a world-leading global bank. We have approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 100 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. We provide consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. We enable clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

Overview of the organization
:

The COO Enterprise Solution Engineering capability is responsible for the development of best-in-class technology platforms for Operations, including development of an integrated portfolio of Operations tools, end-to-end solution design for large scale transformation initiatives, design governance, and adoption of Generative AI solutions for driving operational efficiencies.

Job Description

We are hiring a Technology Director to lead the design and development of a critical Cash & Intraday Liquidity Management platform. This is a senior level position that will provide leadership for the development of a platform that sits at the intersection of engineering ambition and real-world financial impact — for a wide range of internal and external consumers. This is a rare opportunity for a hands-on engineering leader to own a multi-year technical roadmap, build and scale a world-class global engineering organization, and deliver AI-first, cloud-native systems that operate with the highest standards of availability across multiple geographies and regulatory environments. If you are energized by hard product development, solution architecture and engineering problems, thrive at the intersection of solution vision, technical depth & organizational scale, and want your work to matter at a global level — this role is built for you. Individual will apply in-depth domain knowledge of financial services to grasp all facets of the multiple dimensional business problems and develop solution options. The individual will lead a team of technical business analysts, data analysts, and solution architects to deliver solution design for real-world business problems. Individual must have a passion for architectural simplification, and a demonstrable commitment for building sustainable, future-ready platforms

Individual needs to be results-oriented, innovative and motivated to drive opportunities in efficiency gains, enhanced controls and extendible scalability. This is articulated and demonstrated through various types of strong deliver artifacts. This high performing team designs enterprise-wide solutions for critical business needs leveraging solutions, business, technical, and data architecture. Key stakeholders include operations teams, product teams and application development teams from different LoBs & functions within the organization. These engagements are global.

Responsibilities
:

Develop solution design options for enterprise-wide initiatives, evaluate the art of the possible, and devise recommendation options across several evaluation dimensions

Establish collaborative partnerships with local and global teams to deliver enterprise-wide innovative but pragmatic solutions

Partner with SMEs across the CTO organization to understand emerging engineering, architecture standards and apply them across critical initiatives
Evaluates and tests potential architecture solution designs to ensure they meet functional and non-functional requirements
Ensure that all integration of functions fulfill business goals
Define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process enhancements
Identify problem causality, business impact and root causes
Exhibit knowledge of how own specialty area contributes to the business and apply knowledge of competitors, products and services
Strong experience in data structures and its impact on design principles as well as proposals
Advise or mentor junior team members
Impact the solution design by influencing decisions through advice, counsel or facilitating services
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Education and Experience
:

Degree / post graduate degree, preferably in computer science, computer engineering or business / management
15+ years of relevant experience in an engineering and architectural role in Cash Management, Intra-day Liquidity, Payments, and reporting areas in Financial Services
12+ years experience in leading teams to deliver large scale enterprise architecture initiatives within banking, financial services industry
Strong understanding of banking systems, financial services platforms, core banking, data platforms, market infrastructure providers, and regulatory frameworks
Prior experience in Cash / Intraday Liquidity management and Payments is plus
Experience working on large technology projects using industry-standard delivery methodologies (e.g., Agile/Scrum/Kanban)
Ability to develop working relationships
Management and prioritization skills
Strong decision making, forward thinking and creative problem-solving skills to anticipate and respond quickly to technological/market influences
Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
Comprehensive knowledge of design metrics, analytics tools, benchmarking activities and related reporting to identify best practices
Demonstrated analytic/diagnostic skills
Ability to work independently, multi-task, and take ownership of various parts of a project or initiative
Ability to work under pressure and manage to tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements
Ability to build and manage strong teams

jobs.title: VP of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
SkyWater has been retained by a private equity backed SaaS company in the Twin Cities Metro to attract and hire a VP of Software Engineering. This is a newly created leadership seat, not a backfill. The company has been around more than 20 years and is looking to shift from a tech-enabled business to a true software and data company.

As the VP, you would own the technology roadmap end to end. That includes leading a team of 15+ engineers, migrating a legacy on-prem environment to the cloud, standing up compliance, and building out new self-serve, BI-driven product tools for customers and their partners. You would work closely with a product leader on the roadmap but own the technology function outright and report into the senior leadership team.

Non-negotiables: hands-on experience taking a company through a real cloud modernization, current and genuine use of AI-assisted development tools and workflows, and the ability to work in office in the Metro (with flexibility).

What makes this worth leaving a current seat for: real ownership of a technology function at a growth-stage company with fresh capital behind it, a builder’s mandate with room to shape the org and the stack from close to scratch, and equity participation tied to the company’s next phase of growth.

Base salary is in the low to mid 200s, with bonus and equity potential. To apply or learn more, reach out confidentially to Zac Kallas at SkyWater Search Partners.

Responsibilities

Own the multi-year technology roadmap and lead the migration of a legacy, on-prem environment to the cloud
Lead a team of 15 to 25 engineers, establishing a culture of accountability, ownership, and speed across a group with a wide range of tenure
Own the technical vision for new self-serve, BI-driven portals and dashboards used by retail customers and their manufacturer partners
Work closely with a product leader to prioritize and monetize new product capabilities across the mobile app and loyalty platform
Lead the effort to modularize the product suite so new features roll out consistently across the full customer base
Oversee the company's SOC 2 compliance initiative alongside an external compliance advisor, aligned to the cloud transition
Address data quality and integration issues across core business systems and establish clean data governance
Apply a disciplined buy versus build approach when evaluating new vendors and technology partners
Partner with marketing, operations, and sales leadership to align technology investment with growth objectives
Support technical diligence on potential acquisition targets, including assessment of technology footprint and integration risk
Champion the adoption of modern AI-assisted development tools and workflows across the engineering organization

Desired Skills And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
Significant progressive software engineering leadership experience, including direct management of engineering teams and departmental budgets
Demonstrated experience building and scaling modern, cloud-based software products at a small or mid-size company, including through a period of real growth
Hands-on, current use of AI-assisted development tools and workflows, not just familiarity with the concept
Strong experience with vendor evaluation, technology partnerships, and a buy versus build approach to problem solving
Ability to work in office in the Twin Cities Metro
Cannot require sponsorship

jobs.title: Vice President, Global Network Engineering
jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Personal Information We Collect

Your Privacy Choices

Team Overview

The Global Infrastructure, Engineering & Operations (GIO) organization is responsible for delivering TransUnion's enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, operational services, and foundational technology capabilities that support business growth, resiliency, security, and innovation worldwide.

The Vice President, Global Network Engineering will lead the strategy, engineering, modernization, and reliability of TransUnion's global network services. This executive will oversee the network foundation connecting cloud, on-premises, data center, corporate, partner, and customer-facing environments while driving the transformation toward modern, automated, service-oriented networking capabilities.

This role reports directly to the Senior Vice President of Global Infrastructure, Engineering & Operations and serves as a key technology leader responsible for advancing network resiliency, cloud connectivity, automation, observability, and operational excellence across the enterprise. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The Vice President, Global Network Engineering is responsible for defining and executing the global network strategy while ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available network services that enable critical business operations and technology initiatives.

Lead the global network strategy, architecture, engineering, and roadmap across LAN, WAN, cloud, data center, internet edge, partner connectivity, and corporate network environments.
Drive modernization of network services supporting hybrid and multi-cloud platforms, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and on-premises infrastructure.
Simplify network complexity through standardization, segmentation, resiliency improvements, lifecycle management, and architectural modernization initiatives.
Establish and mature a service-based operating model with clearly defined network services, ownership, performance measures, support models, and continuous improvement plans.
Partner with cloud, platform, architecture, DevOps, infrastructure, and security teams to improve consumption of network services through automation, standard designs, and self-service capabilities.
Strengthen network reliability through disciplined incident management, problem management, change governance, root cause analysis, and corrective action execution.
Advance network observability, automation, telemetry, event correlation, and AI-enabled operational capabilities to improve service availability and reduce operational complexity.
Integrate security, compliance, segmentation, auditability, access controls, and policy-driven governance into network designs and operational practices.
Own network capacity planning, technology lifecycle management, vendor partnerships, investment strategies, and cost optimization initiatives.
Build and lead a high-performing global engineering organization focused on accountability, innovation, service ownership, technical excellence, and customer outcomes.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

Fidelity Wealth’s Trade Management Engineering group is responsible for building world-class electronic trading solutions for Fidelity’s Capital Markets division. jobs.title: VP, Head of New Frontier Technology
jobs.description:
Location Designation:
Hybrid - 3 days per quarter

Vice President, Head of New Frontier Technology (West Coast)

Role Summary

AI capability is advancing faster than any single enterprise can track from one location, and the organizations setting the pace — the frontier AI research labs and the hyperscale cloud and AI platform providers — are concentrated on the West Coast. New York Life needs a senior leader embedded in that ecosystem, accountable both for the relationships and for what the firm builds as a result.

This is a leadership role in two distinct senses. It is a coverage role: the Vice President is New York Life's designated senior point of contact for frontier AI labs and hyperscaler platform providers, owning the technical dialogue, the early visibility that comes with those relationships, and senior AI leadership coverage in the Pacific time zone. It is also a people and delivery leadership role: the Vice President builds and leads a team that delivers in-house AI solutions — and the business cases behind them — into production.

The scope of the role is the New York Life AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE), across three dimensions: process, platform, and people. The Vice President owns how AI work moves to production, what the AI CoE builds on and how governance is integrated into it, and the recruiting and upskilling that supply the capability to deliver. All three are accountable to the same outcome — production deliveries — and the mandate is explicitly not innovation for innovation's sake.

Key Responsibilities

Frontier AI Lab and Hyperscaler Coverage

Serve as New York Life's designated senior relationship owner for frontier AI research labs and hyperscale cloud and AI platform and NYL solution providers — the primary impetus for establishing a West Coast presence.
Own the technical dialogue with these providers: model and product roadmaps, research directions, pre-release and early-access programs, and capacity and platform considerations, in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, Sourcing, and Information Security.
Maintain a defined coverage model — named providers, engagement cadence, briefing and roadmap review schedule, and a documented view of each provider's trajectory against the NYL AI CoE's needs.
Represent New York Life at technical conferences, research forums, and industry events where senior representation is expected, and act as a consistent point of contact for the external AI community.
Translate coverage into actionable intelligence for AI, technology, and business leadership: what is changing, what it means for the AI CoE roadmap and architecture, and what the firm should do about it.

Process — The AI Software Development Lifecycle

Own the AI CoE's software development lifecycle: how an initiative moves from hypothesis and evaluation through prototype, pilot, production, and ongoing monitoring, with defined entry and exit criteria at each stage.
Establish the engineering practices particular to AI systems: evaluation-driven development, dataset and prompt versioning, regression and safety testing, red-teaming, human-in-the-loop review, and CI/CD adapted for models and agents.
Design governance, risk, security, privacy, and compliance checkpoints into the lifecycle so approvals are a planned step rather than a late-stage obstacle.
Own post-deployment discipline: observability, model and prompt change management, drift and quality monitoring, incident response, and deprecation and migration playbooks as providers retire and replace models.
Measure and improve cycle time from idea to production, and publish the lifecycle as the standard that delivery teams across New York Life can follow.

Platform — Technologies and Governance Integration

Own the identification, evaluation, and hands-on exploration of emerging technologies with direct relevance to the New York Life AI CoE — foundation models and model routing, agentic frameworks and orchestration, retrieval and context management, evaluation and observability, inference infrastructure, and new AI developing SDLC and tooling.
Maintain a prioritized evaluation portfolio tied to the AI CoE roadmap, with success criteria established up front; retire initiatives that do not clear them and scale those that do.
Own the architectural recommendation on adoption: reference architectures, integration patterns, build-versus-buy positions, and platform standards, developed with AI engineering teams and Enterprise Architecture.
Integrate enterprise governance into the platform itself — model inventory and registry, data access and entitlement patterns, logging and auditability, guardrails and content controls, and evaluation harnesses delivered as shared services — so that every solution built on the platform inherits its controls.
Keep the platform ahead of provider change, using coverage intelligence so that model and infrastructure shifts are anticipated rather than absorbed reactively.

People — Recruiting and Upskilling

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of senior AI talent sourced from frontier AI labs, hyperscalers, large-scale AI engineering organizations, and academic research groups, and engage senior technologists and researchers who could become New York Life AI leaders, architects, or full-stack AI engineers.
Partner with Talent Acquisition and Human Resources to convert relationships into hires, and act as a credible ambassador for New York Life's AI mission and engineering culture.
Build, lead, and develop the West Coast AI engineering and solution delivery team; set performance expectations and retain talent in a highly competitive market.
Own the AI capability uplift for New York Life's existing engineering population: curriculum, enablement materials, hands-on labs, embedded pairing and rotations, internal certification, and a community of practice anchored in the AI CoE's lifecycle and platform standards.
Make upskilling measurable — practitioners trained and certified, teams able to deliver on the platform without hands-on CoE support, and reduced dependency on external vendors for AI delivery.

Production Delivery and Team Leadership

Own delivery end to end for the in-house AI solutions this team builds: business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption, and measured outcome.
Partner with business units and with AI, Data, and Technology leadership to define the business case for each solution — value hypothesis, KPIs, funding, and adoption plan — and remain accountable for value realization after deployment.
Ensure in-house solutions are built on and strengthen shared AI CoE capabilities and reusable assets rather than accumulating as one-off point solutions.
Hold the three pillars accountable to delivery, reporting on process, platform, and people in terms of their effect on production outcomes.

West Coast AI Leadership Coverage

Provide senior AI leadership coverage in the Pacific time zone for high-priority initiatives involving West Coast providers, partners, and engineering resources outside East Coast business hours.
Serve as an escalation point for time-sensitive AI matters arising late in the East Coast business day (NYL AI production support, etc), with a documented escalation path into Home Office AI leadership.
Maintain strong working alignment with Home Office AI leadership despite time-zone separation and represent Home Office positions accurately on the West Coast.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years of progressive experience in technology, including at least 5 years in senior leadership of AI, machine learning, or advanced engineering functions, with direct people leadership of engineering, platform, or architecture teams.
Established senior relationships across frontier AI labs, hyperscale cloud and AI platform providers, and the West Coast senior AI talent market.
Proven track record of building and leading teams that delivered AI solutions from concept to production at enterprise scale, with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ownership of an engineering lifecycle for AI or machine learning systems — evaluation, testing, release, monitoring, and change management — at enterprise scale.
Architectural depth: demonstrated ownership of platform and reference architecture decisions for AI systems, including build-versus-buy judgment and integration into complex enterprise environments.
Experience integrating governance, risk, security, and compliance controls into a delivery platform or lifecycle in a regulated environment, as engineered capability rather than manual process.
Deep, current, hands-on understanding of the modern AI stack: foundation models, agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation, orchestration frameworks, and AI infrastructure.
Demonstrated success attracting and recruiting senior technical talent, and a track record of building technical capability in others through enablement, training, or engineering academies.
Ability to build and defend a business case, and comfort being held accountable for value delivered rather than activity.
Executive presence and credibility sufficient to represent a Fortune 100 company to researchers, platform executives, and senior industry leaders.
Ability and willingness to operate across time zones and travel regularly to the New York Home Office.

Preferred

Experience in financial services, insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
Prior experience at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or large-scale AI platform organization.
Experience establishing or running a center of excellence, platform organization, or enterprise engineering standard.
Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Public presence in the AI community — speaking, publishing, open-source contribution, or research.

Pay Transparency

jobs.description:
Location Designation:
Hybrid - 3 days per week

Role Summary

As AI adoption expands rapidly across the enterprise, New York Life’s governance function must evolve significantly beyond the traditional review-and-approval model. The current team has established a strong foundation in AI model validation; the next phase requires a technology-enabled governance organization centered on automation, enablement, and continuous oversight.

The Head of AI Governance will build and lead that capability. The role pairs deep governance, risk, and regulatory expertise with hands-on command of modern AI technology — because the governance itself will increasingly be delivered through AI agents operating across the software development lifecycle. Equally important is the operating philosophy: AI Governance acts as a coach and enabler, not simply a judge. The objective is to help business and delivery teams adopt AI safely and quickly, rather than to say "no."

Key Responsibilities

AI Governance Enforcement Through Agentic Solutions

Lead the design, development, and operation of a suite of AI governance agents, including:

AI model security and backdoor scanning agents operating at and after deployment.
AI model risk classification and monitoring agents spanning the full SDLC through post-deployment.
AI compliance agents operating continuously across planning, development, deployment, and production.
AI legal agents that assess terms of use, contracts, licensing obligations, permitted use cases, and regulatory requirements.
AI auditing agents spanning the full SDLC through post-deployment.

Ensure the governance agents integrate with existing enterprise systems and control frameworks, including audit, compliance, risk, and security platforms, so that oversight is continuous, evidenced, and auditable rather than point-in-time.

Expert Governance Review and Enablement Team

Lead a highly experienced team responsible for reviewing complex scenarios that cannot be fully resolved by governance agents.
Ensure the team does not function as a simple approval-or-rejection body. When a proposal cannot proceed as requested, the team identifies alternative approaches and practical paths forward.
Establish service levels, escalation paths, and decision rights that keep governance responsive to the pace of delivery.
Build governance literacy across the business and technology organizations through guidance, patterns, and reusable controls.

Internal and External Representation

Represent New York Life AI in enterprise governance, risk, compliance, legal, and technology forums, including senior committees.
Participate in external AI governance, legal, regulatory, and industry working groups to ensure New York Life remains aligned with evolving standards and best practices.
Support regulatory examinations, audits, and due diligence requests relating to AI.

Governance Framework Evolution

Continuously identify emerging governance needs and risks as the technology and regulatory landscape evolves.
Define, update, and improve AI guardrails, standards, policies, and control frameworks.
Ensuring governance remains practical, business-aligned, and responsive to the pace of AI innovation.
Establish metrics and reporting that give senior leadership a clear, current view of AI risk posture across the enterprise.

Enterprise-Wide Governance Coverage

Lead Governance Across Three Distinct Tiers

Tier 1 — Enterprise AI applications operating within New York Life-managed environments and tenants.
Tier 2 — Employee productivity tools, personal AI assistants, and agentic workflows.
Tier 3 — Vendor-provided AI and SaaS solutions where AI capabilities operate outside New York Life-managed environments.

Tier 3 is expected to require substantial focus. Vendors vary significantly in how they process, retain, govern, and utilize New York Life business data, and effective governance in this area will become increasingly critical as AI capabilities are embedded into more third-party platforms.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years of experience across technology risk, model risk management, AI/ML governance, compliance, or a closely related discipline, including significant leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience building or substantially modernizing a governance function — not solely operating an existing one.
Hands-on fluency with modern AI technology: foundation models, agentic systems, MLOps, evaluation and monitoring tooling, and AI security concerns such as prompt injection, data leakage, and supply-chain risk.
Working command of the AI regulatory and standards landscape relevant to U.S. insurance and financial services, including NIST AI RMF, NAIC model guidance, NYDFS expectations, SR 11-7 model risk principles, and emerging state and international AI regulation.
Proven ability to influence and partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Information Security, and Procurement at a senior level.
Experience governing third-party and vendor-embedded AI capabilities.
Executive communication skills, including the ability to present to board-level and regulatory audiences.

Preferred

Insurance or financial services experience in a regulated, enterprise-scale environment.
Prior engagement in external AI governance, standards, or industry working groups.
Technical background sufficient to specify and oversee the build of governance automation and agents.
Advanced degree in law, risk, computer science, statistics, or a related field.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $270,000 - $320,000

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Engineering – Kernel and Software Platforms
jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform relies on continuous performance excellence at every stage of development. We are seeking an outstanding Performance Analysis Manager to lead an engineering team responsible for supervising and optimizing product performance throughout the full hardware lifecycle. In this role, you will bridge the gap between design-time predictions and real-world execution: evaluating performance from early simulation and emulation, through post-silicon bring-up, to production hardware and ongoing release support. Your role involves analyzing kernel authoring flows from DSLs to internal code representations. You will set expectation models, curate workload testlists, and coordinate with CUDA release schedules. Additionally, you will promote automation with AI tools such as Claude and Codex.

What You'll Be Doing

End-to-End Lifecycle Performance Tracking: Supervise and maintain continuous performance tracking for GPU software products from pre-silicon build time, simulation, and emulation environments through initial post-silicon validation, product hardware, and post-release maintenance.
Expectation Modeling & Correlation: Architect theoretical and empirical performance models to set targets early in design. Continuously correlate pre-silicon simulation predictions against early hardware and production silicon to diagnose and eliminate discrepancies.
DSL-to-IR Flow Analysis: Evaluate and benchmark performance translation across diverse kernel authoring flows—analyzing code efficiency from high-level DSLs (e.g., Triton, PyTorch) through compiler Intermediate Representations (IRs) down to target hardware execution across every phase of platform maturity.
Workload Synthesis & Testlist Build: Identify, craft, and maintain stress-test suites and workload testlists representative of production applications. Use these testlists to stress system performance, detect regressions early in simulation, and validate hardware release candidates.
CUDA Release Cadence Alignment: Work multi-functionally with compiler, architecture, and platform software teams to ensure performance achievements hit target expectations on schedules strictly linked to the CUDA release timeline.
Workflow Automation Using Advanced Technology: Integrate modern AI infrastructure (e.g., Claude, OpenAI Codex, agentic LLM workflows) to automate telemetry analysis, root-cause pre-vs-post silicon performance deltas, and streamline performance reporting pipelines.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ overall years of experience in systems/software performance engineering, platform benchmarking, or a related area.
5+ years of experience leading or managing technical engineering teams.
Full Lifecycle Experience: Demonstrated track record tracking performance through the entire hardware pipeline—from design-time simulation/emulation infrastructure to early post-silicon bring-up and deployed production hardware.
Performance Modeling & Telemetry: Proven track record to build expectation models and correlate simulation predictions with physical hardware telemetry without needing to be a daily low-level kernel developer.
DSL & Compiler Pipeline Context: Understanding of modern kernel compilation pipelines, compiler flows (DSL -> IR -> target code), and how high-level software abstraction impacts low-level execution efficiency.
Release & Testlist Management: Experience developing workload testlists to detect performance regressions and aligning performance delivery with major software release cycles (e.g., CUDA cadence).
AI Tooling & Automation: Proficiency in Python automation with practical experience employing generative AI APIs/models (Codex, Claude, custom agents) to automate triage and analytical workflows.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Pre-Silicon Correlation Pipelines: Experience building automated "shift-left" performance validation frameworks that map pre-silicon simulator data directly against post-silicon measurements.

jobs.title: Financial Services Technology Consulting, SI-SAP Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity:

Our Financial Services ("FSO") teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!

We live in a new digital world with exciting new technologies and challenges. Financial institutions are going through a seismic change in their business that also provides significant opportunities through a deep finance, risk and technology transformation. Large institutions in Banking, Insurance and Capital Markets are re-evaluating the way they conduct business and are undergoing strategic initiatives to enhance their operations to better serve their clients and address the high bar set by the regulator.

At EY, we pride ourselves on being a trusted advisor to the key stakeholders in the financial services industry. Our vision and flawless execution have driven a substantial growth in our organization. As a result, we are currently looking to expand our team by bringing on board new leaders with the commitment and drive to help our clients succeed. Due to the tremendous growth of the SAP platform, we need individuals versed in the technology that have relevant experience and a well-rounded skillset based on previous successful implementation lifecycles. This is an opportunity with tremendous growth potential for very motivated individuals that observe a strong work ethic. EY is working hard to turn our clients' SAP platform deployments into end-to-end change enablers that bring the true meaning of digital to bear. Instead of delivering isolated technology solutions, we are passionate about helping our clients develop new business processes which complement and leverage their technology ecosystem, helping them to realize far-reaching organizational benefits.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Senior Manager in our SAP Financial Services practice, you are expected to be a leader across both program delivery and practice development. This role requires a strong focus program sales and delivery along with people leadership. Development of our consulting staff and practice delivery capabilities will be critical aspects of your role.

Skills and attributes for success:

A successful senior manager will be drive Firm development initiatives and manage sub-practice areas. The ability to lead multiple threads of work and teams successfully is critical to your success. You will be a critical member of the leadership team working with our program leads and key subject matter advisors (SMA) to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive solution will be delivered on-time and on-budget to the utmost satisfaction of our clients.

Ideal candidates for this role will have the following skills and attributes:

10+ years of work experience, including 8+ year of system implementation execution including experience with the full system development lifecycle delivery
Experience with leading cross functional programs from 10-20 resources onsite and 30+ offshore / global delivery
Provent track record of sales and delivery of managed revenue in the profession service field including development strategic responses to client requests for proposals
Deep understanding of SAP based transformation and drivers for efficiency leveraging core S/4 capabilities
Experience leading teams through initial program phases including business case development and program support infrastructure stand up
Understanding AI based delivery capabilities and methodologies
A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience at a financial services company or comparable experience working
Exceptional written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills
Strong focus on developing staff through mentoring and coaching
Undergraduate / Graduate degree in computer science, engineering, accounting, finance or a related field
Prior consulting industry experience
Experience with at least one full cycle implementation of your core module
A willingness to work in EY offices averaging 2-3 days per week and travel as needed to client project sites – estimated at 25-30%

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $171,600 to $392,100. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $205,900 to $445,700. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

EY provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, genetic information, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, in accordance with applicable law. 

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

Experience with change management, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational documentation.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior leadership, auditors, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulated environment with strong operational controls, documentation standards, and risk management expectations.

Experience in the banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience supporting core banking platforms, payment systems, loan systems, treasury applications, or other business-critical financial workloads.

Experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools, storage area networks, replication technologies, and data retention controls.
Experience managing AIX on IBM Power Systems in support of critical applications.
Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.

Experience with monitoring and observability platforms for infrastructure health, alerting, and performance analytics.
Familiarity with Active Directory, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, file services, and identity-integrated infrastructure services.
Experience participating in or leading disaster recovery exercises, cyber recovery planning, and resilience testing.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager – DGX Enterprise Infrastructure and Cloud-Native Operations
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a world-class Senior Product Manager to architect for the operational future of Enterprise AI. While the NVIDIA DGX is the undisputed "Gold Standard" for AI performance, the enterprise on-premise environment presents an outstanding challenge: How do you make a 1,000-node private cluster feel as fluid, scalable, and invisible as the public cloud? The mission is to deliver the "NVIDIA Experience" within the customer’s data center. In this role, own the software-defined blueprint that transforms raw DGX hardware into a high-availability, self-healing AI Factory!

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, set the vision for the Enterprise Operational Gold Standard. You will define how the world’s most sophisticated companies deploy, manage, and scale their Enterprise AI Factories.

Productize the On-Prem Lifecycle: Define the "Day 0 through Day 2" experience for DGX SuperPODs. Lead the development of products that handle everything from bare-metal provisioning and network fabric configuration to automated "one-click" firmware rollouts.
Build the "Pit Crew" (Observability): Develop a definitive telemetry and diagnostic suite. When a job slows down in a private data center, your framework should provide the "one-click" answer—isolating a thermal throttle, a degraded InfiniBand rail, or a cabling fault instantly.
Bridge Hardware to Kubernetes: Lead the integration of DGX systems into the cloud-native ecosystem. Ensure that enterprise-grade features like GPU partitioning (MIG), multi-node scaling, and niche scheduling are declarative and seamless.
Standardize at Scale: You aren't just building scripts; but building APIs and Services. Your goal is to eliminate "management snowflakes," ensuring that every enterprise DGX deployment is standardized, repeatable, and resilient.
Drive Predictive Operations: Move the needle from reactive maintenance to self-healing infrastructure. Thoughtfully define the features for automated health checks that keep the fleet at peak performance without manual intervention.

What We Need To See

Enterprise Data Center DNA: 12+ years demonstrated ability in Product Management,,with specific around on-premise infrastructure, private cloud, or large-scale systems management.
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience.
The "Platform-First" Approach: A track record of turning complex hardware operations into software-defined workflows. You understand that in the enterprise, Product = Hardware + Software + Operations.
Cloud-Native Expertise: Expert-level understanding of Kubernetes operators, container orchestration, and how to translate physical hardware constraints into declarative code.
Operational Scars: You’ve lived through the challenges of managing large-scale Linux fleets in air-gapped or restricted enterprise environments. You know what keeps SREs up at night.
Technical Breadth: Deep familiarity with data center networking (InfiniBand/Ethernet), storage architectures, and the firmware-to-OS handshake.
Leadership & Evolution: This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of multiple engineering fields. As you define the NVIDIA Datacenter Experience, you will be positioned on a direct leadership track, with the explicit expectation to transition into formal people management as the team expands.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Automation Evangelist: You have experience with infrastructure-as-code (Ansible, Terraform, Pulumi) in a bare-metal context.

new_jobs.title: Director of ML Engineering - Conversation Product Area
new_jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify's Personalization mission (PZN) is building the single intelligence layer that powers how hundreds of millions of people discover and experience audio. One agent, one reasoning engine, and one taste model, moving to a unified single stack.

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Conversation Product Area. The Conversation Product Area is the technical center of gravity for the shift to one Agent, building the shared Agent Engine harness and the evaluation infrastructure that supports it. The Product Area also owns the Search Brain (intent routing and search-driven conversation) the intent-detection and prompt-suggestion platform behind our agentic consumer features like Chat and AI DJ, and the Speak Platform, Spotify's first-party voice team, which spans applied research, production infrastructure, and the character/brand decisions behind every voice Spotify users hear. This is the engineering org where architecture decisions get made that power every agentic surface at the company.

You'll be working with many of Spotify's senior architects, with product leadership in the consumer AI space, and with cross functional partners. The team needs a leader who is as comfortable making critical architectural calls as they are managing the people making them.

What You'll Do

Own engineering execution and technical direction for the Conversation Product Area, including the Agent Engine, the evaluation infrastructure, the Search platform, the AI Voice platform (Speak), and some consumer agentic features built on top of the Agent Engine. This spans production systems at massive scale, applied ML research, and infrastructure that other product areas depend on.
Co-lead the Product Area in a paired product/engineering model. You own engineering and deeply partner with a product counterpart that owns product strategy. You’ll operate as a single leadership unit for planning, prioritization, and external representation. This partnership is core to the success of the role.
You’ll manage a team of ~70 engineers, with a small team of Senior Engineering Managers and Staff/Principal engineers directly reporting to you. You’ll develop and hold accountable the EM layer running the PA's roughly 9 teams. Your leverage comes through your SEMs and Staff engineers, but you’re ultimately accountable for delivery across the entire product area.
Drive the migration of the company’s existing agentic infrastructure onto the shared Agent Engine, in close partnership product teams across the company, balancing migration speed against product teams’ existing roadmap work.
Own the technical strategy for Spotify's first-party voice investment: what Speak builds versus buys, how the team organizes and delivers against a market that's commoditizing fast, and how the character/brand voice decisions for agent experiences get made and shipped on their own aggressive timelines.
Define and hold the technical bar on evaluation. Build the discipline around building feature-specific judges and datasets and product decisions based on those eval sets.
Set and enforce engineering quality standards appropriate to an AI-assisted development era including code review discipline and test coverage especially designed for teams that are increasingly writing code with AI assistance.
Participate as a full member of the broader leadership group, co-developing with your peers and executives the operating model for the whole studio across capacity management, project prioritization, studio communication principles, and building a healthy engineering culture in a highly changeable environment.
Represent the Conversation PA's engineering point of view in high visibility, company-wide architecture and steerco conversations with senior leaders.

Who You Are

You are deeply technical, not tech-adjacent. This PA's defining work (a new shared agent runtime and harness, a scaled evaluation system, a voice/speech stack) requires a Director who can evaluate architecture proposals, hold their own in a room with senior ICs, contribute technically in meaningful ways, and make tough tiebreaking and tradeoff calls.
You have run large engineering orgs through platform consolidations, migrations, or evolutions, and you’ve had to earn trust by building highly scaled and functional platform technology.
You have experience with at least two of: LLM-based agent systems and orchestration, evaluation/eval-infrastructure design (including automated judges and regression suites), large-scale retrieval or search systems, or speech/voice ML systems and production voice infrastructure.
You've managed managers, not just individual contributors. You know how to build a management structure that scales.
You have a track record of building strong but nimble teams, with experience restructuring, shifting team resourcing, adjusting to fast changing priorities or shifting needs without losing delivery momentum.

Where You'll Be

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas or EMEA region as long as we have a work location.
This team operates primarily within the Eastern North America and Central European time zones for collaboration, so we ask that you be located within a time zone that enables regular overlap with the team.

The United States base range for this position is $281,196 – $401,709 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know – we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

The Vice President, Global Network Engineering is responsible for defining and executing the global network strategy while ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, and highly available network services that enable critical business operations and technology initiatives.

Lead the global network strategy, architecture, engineering, and roadmap across LAN, WAN, cloud, data center, internet edge, partner connectivity, and corporate network environments.
