new_jobs.title: VP, Head of New Frontier Technology
new_jobs.description:
Location Designation:
Hybrid - 3 days per quarter

Vice President, Head of New Frontier Technology (West Coast)

Role Summary

AI capability is advancing faster than any single enterprise can track from one location, and the organizations setting the pace — the frontier AI research labs and the hyperscale cloud and AI platform providers — are concentrated on the West Coast. New York Life needs a senior leader embedded in that ecosystem, accountable both for the relationships and for what the firm builds as a result.

This is a leadership role in two distinct senses. It is a coverage role: the Vice President is New York Life's designated senior point of contact for frontier AI labs and hyperscaler platform providers, owning the technical dialogue, the early visibility that comes with those relationships, and senior AI leadership coverage in the Pacific time zone. It is also a people and delivery leadership role: the Vice President builds and leads a team that delivers in-house AI solutions — and the business cases behind them — into production.

The scope of the role is the New York Life AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE), across three dimensions: process, platform, and people. The Vice President owns how AI work moves to production, what the AI CoE builds on and how governance is integrated into it, and the recruiting and upskilling that supply the capability to deliver. All three are accountable to the same outcome — production deliveries — and the mandate is explicitly not innovation for innovation's sake.

Key Responsibilities

Frontier AI Lab and Hyperscaler Coverage

Serve as New York Life's designated senior relationship owner for frontier AI research labs and hyperscale cloud and AI platform and NYL solution providers — the primary impetus for establishing a West Coast presence.
Own the technical dialogue with these providers: model and product roadmaps, research directions, pre-release and early-access programs, and capacity and platform considerations, in partnership with Enterprise Architecture, Sourcing, and Information Security.
Maintain a defined coverage model — named providers, engagement cadence, briefing and roadmap review schedule, and a documented view of each provider's trajectory against the NYL AI CoE's needs.
Represent New York Life at technical conferences, research forums, and industry events where senior representation is expected, and act as a consistent point of contact for the external AI community.
Translate coverage into actionable intelligence for AI, technology, and business leadership: what is changing, what it means for the AI CoE roadmap and architecture, and what the firm should do about it.

Process — The AI Software Development Lifecycle

Own the AI CoE's software development lifecycle: how an initiative moves from hypothesis and evaluation through prototype, pilot, production, and ongoing monitoring, with defined entry and exit criteria at each stage.
Establish the engineering practices particular to AI systems: evaluation-driven development, dataset and prompt versioning, regression and safety testing, red-teaming, human-in-the-loop review, and CI/CD adapted for models and agents.
Design governance, risk, security, privacy, and compliance checkpoints into the lifecycle so approvals are a planned step rather than a late-stage obstacle.
Own post-deployment discipline: observability, model and prompt change management, drift and quality monitoring, incident response, and deprecation and migration playbooks as providers retire and replace models.
Measure and improve cycle time from idea to production, and publish the lifecycle as the standard that delivery teams across New York Life can follow.

Platform — Technologies and Governance Integration

Own the identification, evaluation, and hands-on exploration of emerging technologies with direct relevance to the New York Life AI CoE — foundation models and model routing, agentic frameworks and orchestration, retrieval and context management, evaluation and observability, inference infrastructure, and new AI developing SDLC and tooling.
Maintain a prioritized evaluation portfolio tied to the AI CoE roadmap, with success criteria established up front; retire initiatives that do not clear them and scale those that do.
Own the architectural recommendation on adoption: reference architectures, integration patterns, build-versus-buy positions, and platform standards, developed with AI engineering teams and Enterprise Architecture.
Integrate enterprise governance into the platform itself — model inventory and registry, data access and entitlement patterns, logging and auditability, guardrails and content controls, and evaluation harnesses delivered as shared services — so that every solution built on the platform inherits its controls.
Keep the platform ahead of provider change, using coverage intelligence so that model and infrastructure shifts are anticipated rather than absorbed reactively.

People — Recruiting and Upskilling

Build and maintain a strong pipeline of senior AI talent sourced from frontier AI labs, hyperscalers, large-scale AI engineering organizations, and academic research groups, and engage senior technologists and researchers who could become New York Life AI leaders, architects, or full-stack AI engineers.
Partner with Talent Acquisition and Human Resources to convert relationships into hires, and act as a credible ambassador for New York Life's AI mission and engineering culture.
Build, lead, and develop the West Coast AI engineering and solution delivery team; set performance expectations and retain talent in a highly competitive market.
Own the AI capability uplift for New York Life's existing engineering population: curriculum, enablement materials, hands-on labs, embedded pairing and rotations, internal certification, and a community of practice anchored in the AI CoE's lifecycle and platform standards.
Make upskilling measurable — practitioners trained and certified, teams able to deliver on the platform without hands-on CoE support, and reduced dependency on external vendors for AI delivery.

Production Delivery and Team Leadership

Own delivery end to end for the in-house AI solutions this team builds: business case, architecture, build, deployment, adoption, and measured outcome.
Partner with business units and with AI, Data, and Technology leadership to define the business case for each solution — value hypothesis, KPIs, funding, and adoption plan — and remain accountable for value realization after deployment.
Ensure in-house solutions are built on and strengthen shared AI CoE capabilities and reusable assets rather than accumulating as one-off point solutions.
Hold the three pillars accountable to delivery, reporting on process, platform, and people in terms of their effect on production outcomes.

West Coast AI Leadership Coverage

Provide senior AI leadership coverage in the Pacific time zone for high-priority initiatives involving West Coast providers, partners, and engineering resources outside East Coast business hours.
Serve as an escalation point for time-sensitive AI matters arising late in the East Coast business day (NYL AI production support, etc), with a documented escalation path into Home Office AI leadership.
Maintain strong working alignment with Home Office AI leadership despite time-zone separation and represent Home Office positions accurately on the West Coast.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years of progressive experience in technology, including at least 5 years in senior leadership of AI, machine learning, or advanced engineering functions, with direct people leadership of engineering, platform, or architecture teams.
Established senior relationships across frontier AI labs, hyperscale cloud and AI platform providers, and the West Coast senior AI talent market.
Proven track record of building and leading teams that delivered AI solutions from concept to production at enterprise scale, with measurable business outcomes.
Demonstrated ownership of an engineering lifecycle for AI or machine learning systems — evaluation, testing, release, monitoring, and change management — at enterprise scale.
Architectural depth: demonstrated ownership of platform and reference architecture decisions for AI systems, including build-versus-buy judgment and integration into complex enterprise environments.
Experience integrating governance, risk, security, and compliance controls into a delivery platform or lifecycle in a regulated environment, as engineered capability rather than manual process.
Deep, current, hands-on understanding of the modern AI stack: foundation models, agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation, orchestration frameworks, and AI infrastructure.
Demonstrated success attracting and recruiting senior technical talent, and a track record of building technical capability in others through enablement, training, or engineering academies.
Ability to build and defend a business case, and comfort being held accountable for value delivered rather than activity.
Executive presence and credibility sufficient to represent a Fortune 100 company to researchers, platform executives, and senior industry leaders.
Ability and willingness to operate across time zones and travel regularly to the New York Home Office.

Preferred

Experience in financial services, insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
Prior experience at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or large-scale AI platform organization.
Experience establishing or running a center of excellence, platform organization, or enterprise engineering standard.
Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Public presence in the AI community — speaking, publishing, open-source contribution, or research.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $275,000 - $325,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

new_jobs.title: VP, Head of Responsible AI Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Location Designation:
Hybrid - 3 days per week

Role Summary

As AI adoption expands rapidly across the enterprise, New York Life’s governance function must evolve significantly beyond the traditional review-and-approval model. The current team has established a strong foundation in AI model validation; the next phase requires a technology-enabled governance organization centered on automation, enablement, and continuous oversight.

The Head of AI Governance will build and lead that capability. The role pairs deep governance, risk, and regulatory expertise with hands-on command of modern AI technology — because the governance itself will increasingly be delivered through AI agents operating across the software development lifecycle. Equally important is the operating philosophy: AI Governance acts as a coach and enabler, not simply a judge. The objective is to help business and delivery teams adopt AI safely and quickly, rather than to say "no."

Key Responsibilities

AI Governance Enforcement Through Agentic Solutions

Lead the design, development, and operation of a suite of AI governance agents, including:

AI model security and backdoor scanning agents operating at and after deployment.
AI model risk classification and monitoring agents spanning the full SDLC through post-deployment.
AI compliance agents operating continuously across planning, development, deployment, and production.
AI legal agents that assess terms of use, contracts, licensing obligations, permitted use cases, and regulatory requirements.
AI auditing agents spanning the full SDLC through post-deployment.

Ensure the governance agents integrate with existing enterprise systems and control frameworks, including audit, compliance, risk, and security platforms, so that oversight is continuous, evidenced, and auditable rather than point-in-time.

Expert Governance Review and Enablement Team

Lead a highly experienced team responsible for reviewing complex scenarios that cannot be fully resolved by governance agents.
Ensure the team does not function as a simple approval-or-rejection body. When a proposal cannot proceed as requested, the team identifies alternative approaches and practical paths forward.
Establish service levels, escalation paths, and decision rights that keep governance responsive to the pace of delivery.
Build governance literacy across the business and technology organizations through guidance, patterns, and reusable controls.

Internal and External Representation

Represent New York Life AI in enterprise governance, risk, compliance, legal, and technology forums, including senior committees.
Participate in external AI governance, legal, regulatory, and industry working groups to ensure New York Life remains aligned with evolving standards and best practices.
Support regulatory examinations, audits, and due diligence requests relating to AI.

Governance Framework Evolution

Continuously identify emerging governance needs and risks as the technology and regulatory landscape evolves.
Define, update, and improve AI guardrails, standards, policies, and control frameworks.
Ensuring governance remains practical, business-aligned, and responsive to the pace of AI innovation.
Establish metrics and reporting that give senior leadership a clear, current view of AI risk posture across the enterprise.

Enterprise-Wide Governance Coverage

Lead Governance Across Three Distinct Tiers

Tier 1 — Enterprise AI applications operating within New York Life-managed environments and tenants.
Tier 2 — Employee productivity tools, personal AI assistants, and agentic workflows.
Tier 3 — Vendor-provided AI and SaaS solutions where AI capabilities operate outside New York Life-managed environments.

Tier 3 is expected to require substantial focus. Vendors vary significantly in how they process, retain, govern, and utilize New York Life business data, and effective governance in this area will become increasingly critical as AI capabilities are embedded into more third-party platforms.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years of experience across technology risk, model risk management, AI/ML governance, compliance, or a closely related discipline, including significant leadership responsibility.
Demonstrated experience building or substantially modernizing a governance function — not solely operating an existing one.
Hands-on fluency with modern AI technology: foundation models, agentic systems, MLOps, evaluation and monitoring tooling, and AI security concerns such as prompt injection, data leakage, and supply-chain risk.
Working command of the AI regulatory and standards landscape relevant to U.S. insurance and financial services, including NIST AI RMF, NAIC model guidance, NYDFS expectations, SR 11-7 model risk principles, and emerging state and international AI regulation.
Proven ability to influence and partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Information Security, and Procurement at a senior level.
Experience governing third-party and vendor-embedded AI capabilities.
Executive communication skills, including the ability to present to board-level and regulatory audiences.

Preferred

Insurance or financial services experience in a regulated, enterprise-scale environment.
Prior engagement in external AI governance, standards, or industry working groups.
Technical background sufficient to specify and oversee the build of governance automation and agents.
Advanced degree in law, risk, computer science, statistics, or a related field.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $270,000 - $320,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. Here, you’ll find the rare balance of long-standing stability and forward momentum, supported by an inclusive team that honors tradition while embracing progress.

As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Lead and manage the day-to-day operations of infrastructure teams supporting Windows, Linux, AIX, storage, and backup environments across production, disaster recovery, test, and development platforms.
Supervise, coach, and develop system administrators and engineers, including workload management, performance feedback, career development, and team planning.

Maintain operational readiness for backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring recovery objectives are documented, tested, and achievable.
Partner with cybersecurity and risk teams to implement secure configuration standards, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, endpoint hardening, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations.
Establish and enforce infrastructure standards for system builds, operational procedures, documentation, change controls, and platform governance.
Coordinate major incident response for supported platforms, providing leadership during outages, service degradation, and recovery events.
Support audits and examinations by preparing evidence, responding to control inquiries, and remediating identified gaps in a timely manner.
Manage vendor relationships for infrastructure hardware, software, maintenance, and support services, including issue escalation and service review.
Contribute to strategic planning for infrastructure modernization, automation, cloud integration where applicable, data center operations, and platform roadmap development.
Collaborate with application and database teams to support system performance, platform tuning, middleware dependencies, and infrastructure requirements for business initiatives.

Previous leadership for technical implementation

Demonstrated experience supporting Windows Server, Linux, AIX, enterprise storage, and backup platforms in a mid-sized or large enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, platform hardening, backup/recovery processes, disaster recovery, and production support.
Experience with change management, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational documentation.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior leadership, auditors, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulated environment with strong operational controls, documentation standards, and risk management expectations.

Experience in the banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.

Familiarity with regulatory and control frameworks relevant to financial institutions, such as FFIEC guidance, SOX, PCI DSS, GLBA, or internal audit standards.
Experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools, storage area networks, replication technologies, and data retention controls.
Experience managing AIX on IBM Power Systems in support of critical applications.
Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
Exposure to infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms for infrastructure health, alerting, and performance analytics.
Familiarity with Active Directory, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, file services, and identity-integrated infrastructure services.
Experience participating in or leading disaster recovery exercises, cyber recovery planning, and resilience testing.
Knowledge of hybrid cloud connectivity and infrastructure integration strategies where applicable.

Skills

Infrastructure leadership with the ability to balance hands-on technical depth and managerial accountability.

Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, standards, runbooks, and procedures.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Performance Engineering – Kernel and Software Platforms
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform relies on continuous performance excellence at every stage of development. We are seeking an outstanding Performance Analysis Manager to lead an engineering team responsible for supervising and optimizing product performance throughout the full hardware lifecycle. In this role, you will bridge the gap between design-time predictions and real-world execution: evaluating performance from early simulation and emulation, through post-silicon bring-up, to production hardware and ongoing release support. Your role involves analyzing kernel authoring flows from DSLs to internal code representations. You will set expectation models, curate workload testlists, and coordinate with CUDA release schedules. Additionally, you will promote automation with AI tools such as Claude and Codex.

What You'll Be Doing

End-to-End Lifecycle Performance Tracking: Supervise and maintain continuous performance tracking for GPU software products from pre-silicon build time, simulation, and emulation environments through initial post-silicon validation, product hardware, and post-release maintenance.
Expectation Modeling & Correlation: Architect theoretical and empirical performance models to set targets early in design. Continuously correlate pre-silicon simulation predictions against early hardware and production silicon to diagnose and eliminate discrepancies.
DSL-to-IR Flow Analysis: Evaluate and benchmark performance translation across diverse kernel authoring flows—analyzing code efficiency from high-level DSLs (e.g., Triton, PyTorch) through compiler Intermediate Representations (IRs) down to target hardware execution across every phase of platform maturity.
Workload Synthesis & Testlist Build: Identify, craft, and maintain stress-test suites and workload testlists representative of production applications. Use these testlists to stress system performance, detect regressions early in simulation, and validate hardware release candidates.
CUDA Release Cadence Alignment: Work multi-functionally with compiler, architecture, and platform software teams to ensure performance achievements hit target expectations on schedules strictly linked to the CUDA release timeline.
Workflow Automation Using Advanced Technology: Integrate modern AI infrastructure (e.g., Claude, OpenAI Codex, agentic LLM workflows) to automate telemetry analysis, root-cause pre-vs-post silicon performance deltas, and streamline performance reporting pipelines.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ overall years of experience in systems/software performance engineering, platform benchmarking, or a related area.
5+ years of experience leading or managing technical engineering teams.
Full Lifecycle Experience: Demonstrated track record tracking performance through the entire hardware pipeline—from design-time simulation/emulation infrastructure to early post-silicon bring-up and deployed production hardware.
Performance Modeling & Telemetry: Proven track record to build expectation models and correlate simulation predictions with physical hardware telemetry without needing to be a daily low-level kernel developer.
DSL & Compiler Pipeline Context: Understanding of modern kernel compilation pipelines, compiler flows (DSL -> IR -> target code), and how high-level software abstraction impacts low-level execution efficiency.
Release & Testlist Management: Experience developing workload testlists to detect performance regressions and aligning performance delivery with major software release cycles (e.g., CUDA cadence).
AI Tooling & Automation: Proficiency in Python automation with practical experience employing generative AI APIs/models (Codex, Claude, custom agents) to automate triage and analytical workflows.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Pre-Silicon Correlation Pipelines: Experience building automated "shift-left" performance validation frameworks that map pre-silicon simulator data directly against post-silicon measurements.
Compiler Stack Insights: Hands-on analytical experience with intermediate representations (MLIR, LLVM IR, NVVM/PTX) to identify performance loss between abstraction layers.
Agentic AI Triage: Proven success designing LLM-driven agents that automatically analyze performance regressions between hardware software releases and summarize root causes.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and collaborative software leader seeking new challenges? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our DL Architecture team and help build the real-time, cost-effective AI computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager IT - Infrastructure Platforms (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Overview

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following location(s): Arizona, North Carolina and Texas.

The Senior IT Manager - Infrastructure Platforms is responsible for leading the administration, support, and operational stability of the bank's core infrastructure platforms, including Windows Server, Linux, AIX, enterprise storage, and backup services. This role provides hands-on leadership for a team of infrastructure professionals and ensures that critical systems are secure, highly available, recoverable, and aligned with business, regulatory, and operational requirements.

This position works closely with Information Security, Architecture, Application Support, Network Engineering, Risk, Audit, and business stakeholders to deliver resilient infrastructure services that support First Citizens Bank applications and enterprise operations. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with people leadership, operational discipline, and experience in regulated environments.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties and Responsibilities:

Lead and manage the day-to-day operations of infrastructure teams supporting Windows, Linux, AIX, storage, and backup environments across production, disaster recovery, test, and development platforms.
Supervise, coach, and develop system administrators and engineers, including workload management, performance feedback, career development, and team planning.
Ensure high availability and reliability of infrastructure services through proactive monitoring, capacity planning, incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement.
Oversee lifecycle management for servers, operating systems, storage platforms, and backup systems, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, decommissioning, and hardware/software currency.
Maintain operational readiness for backup, restore, replication, and disaster recovery capabilities, ensuring recovery objectives are documented, tested, and achievable.
Partner with cybersecurity and risk teams to implement secure configuration standards, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, endpoint hardening, and compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations.
Establish and enforce infrastructure standards for system builds, operational procedures, documentation, change controls, and platform governance.
Coordinate major incident response for supported platforms, providing leadership during outages, service degradation, and recovery events.
Support audits and examinations by preparing evidence, responding to control inquiries, and remediating identified gaps in a timely manner.
Manage vendor relationships for infrastructure hardware, software, maintenance, and support services, including issue escalation and service review.
Contribute to strategic planning for infrastructure modernization, automation, cloud integration where applicable, data center operations, and platform roadmap development.
Collaborate with application and database teams to support system performance, platform tuning, middleware dependencies, and infrastructure requirements for business initiatives.
Drive automation and operational efficiency through scripting, configuration management, standardized deployment processes, and reduction of manual support tasks.
Own capacity and performance management for compute, storage, and backup environments, ensuring sufficient scalability to meet growth and resilience needs.
Ensure adherence to ITIL-aligned processes for incident, problem, change, request, and configuration management.

Position Specific Skills

Previous leadership for technical implementation

Knowledge of Standard Development Life Cycles (like Waterfall or Agile)

Knowledge of system and data design

Qualifications

Minimum Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's Degree and 8 years' experience OR High School Diploma or GED/Equivalent and 12 years' experience in Applications development, analysis or engineering

Preferred Qualifications

7+ years of progressive IT infrastructure experience, including administration or engineering responsibilities across multiple enterprise server platforms.
3+ years of leadership or management experience, including direct supervision of technical staff, team coordination, or technical lead responsibility in a complex environment.
Demonstrated experience supporting Windows Server, Linux, AIX, enterprise storage, and backup platforms in a mid-sized or large enterprise environment.
Strong understanding of infrastructure operations, platform hardening, backup/recovery processes, disaster recovery, and production support.
Experience with change management, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational documentation.
Ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, senior leadership, auditors, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Experience working in a regulated environment with strong operational controls, documentation standards, and risk management expectations.

Preferred Areas Of Experience

Experience in the banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience supporting core banking platforms, payment systems, loan systems, treasury applications, or other business-critical financial workloads.
Familiarity with regulatory and control frameworks relevant to financial institutions, such as FFIEC guidance, SOX, PCI DSS, GLBA, or internal audit standards.
Experience with enterprise backup and recovery tools, storage area networks, replication technologies, and data retention controls.
Experience managing AIX on IBM Power Systems in support of critical applications.
Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
Exposure to infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, or similar tools.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms for infrastructure health, alerting, and performance analytics.
Familiarity with Active Directory, LDAP, DNS, DHCP, file services, and identity-integrated infrastructure services.
Experience participating in or leading disaster recovery exercises, cyber recovery planning, and resilience testing.
Knowledge of hybrid cloud connectivity and infrastructure integration strategies where applicable.

Skills

Infrastructure leadership with the ability to balance hands-on technical depth and managerial accountability.
Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration, including patching, security, troubleshooting, and operational support.
Strong knowledge of Linux administration across enterprise distributions, including performance tuning, scripting, patching, and security management.
Working knowledge of AIX administration, system support, and operational best practices.
Solid understanding of enterprise storage concepts, including SAN/NAS, provisioning, performance, replication, and capacity management.
Solid understanding of backup and recovery operations, including backup scheduling, retention, restore validation, and disaster recovery alignment.
Knowledge of system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure security controls.
Strong skills in incident management, problem management, and root cause analysis.
Ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation, standards, runbooks, and procedures.
Effective people management, mentoring, and team development skills.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and decision-making abilities in fast-paced operational environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate technical issues for non-technical audiences.
Ability to work collaboratively across infrastructure, security, application, audit, and business teams.

Reporting Structure

The role will report into the Sr. Director Infrastructure and Operations and will have direct responsibility for system administrators, infrastructure engineers, or platform specialists.

Work Environment

This role may require participation in an on-call rotation, after-hours maintenance activities, disaster recovery testing, and incident response for critical production systems.

Additional Information

Benefits are an integral part of total rewards and First Citizens Bank is committed to providing a competitive, thoughtfully designed and quality benefits program to meet the needs of our associates. More information can be found at https://jobs.firstcitizens.com/benefits.

new_jobs.description:
Benefits Start Day 1 for Full-Time Colleagues - No Waiting Period!

For more information about our benefits, see below!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

Overview

The Senior Director of Marketing Technology defines, rationalizes, and executes the regional marketing technology architecture and digital customer experience framework to enable corporate revenue growth. This position owns the design, governance, and structural optimization of the enterprise MarTech ecosystem, including corporate CRM platforms, content management systems, customer portals, and automated communication channels. The role is directly accountable for consolidating fragmented systems into a scalable digital platform that optimizes inbound lead capture, automated routing, and accurate multi-touch sales attribution. By partnering with executive leaders across Sales, Customer Care, Data Analytics, and Information Technology, this position establishes a seamless acquisition and retention ecosystem that enhances functional efficiency and margin performance.

Duties & Responsibilities

Formulate and execute the long-term marketing technology roadmap to consolidate disparate platforms, minimize technical debt, and ensure scalability and cost efficiency across North American business lines.
Govern the architecture of the end-to-end digital customer journey across web properties, landing systems, and automated messaging endpoints to drive transaction conversion rates.
Architect and oversee the enterprise inbound lead management pipeline, ensuring automated capture, structural data enrichment, speed-to-lead routing logic, and system integration with downstream sales platforms.
Oversee the evolution and structural maintenance of authenticated customer portals to expand digital self-service capabilities, customer personalization, and targeted cross-sell workflows.
Direct the evaluation, piloting, and scaled deployment of artificial intelligence applications, chatbot natural language processing, and advanced communication automation tools within the marketing stack.
Establish a rigorous data-driven experimentation and testing framework to optimize user experience, messaging hierarchies, and conversion funnels.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Care, and Information Technology executive leaders to align cross-functional system infrastructure, compliance parameters, and master data models.
Build advanced performance measurement frameworks to track and report multi-channel marketing attribution, pipeline performance, and return on investment for technology acquisitions.
Manage direct reports, assign departmental resource allocations, and direct external vendor partnerships and technical consulting relationships.

Candidate Requirements

Education

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field OR equivalent years of experience. Equivalent years of experience are defined as one year of applicable professional experience for each year of college requested.
Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) or technical field preferred.

Experience

Minimum 10 years of professional experience within marketing technology, digital operations, or enterprise CRM management required.
Minimum 5 years of experience leading high-performing teams, managing technology vendor integrations, and directing large-scale platform consolidations required.
Extensive experience governing complex customer data architectures, lead management workflows, and advanced multi-touch revenue attribution models required.
Demonstrated experience implementing automated communication platforms, artificial intelligence service solutions, and conversion optimization programs within high-volume retail or service-based industries preferred.

Skills & Competencies

Deep technical understanding of enterprise CRM suites, content management platforms, marketing automation networks, and customer data infrastructure models.
Advanced financial acumen with a demonstrated capability to track return on investment for complex technology infrastructure deployments.
Outstanding communication capabilities with an established executive presence necessary to negotiate and influence goals across separate corporate business lines.
Expert analytical capability with a deep understanding of data modeling, digital optimization methodologies, and cross-platform dashboard visualization.
Strong leadership capability with a proven track record of managing diverse technical teams and deploying structural process transformations under high-pressure conditions.

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology. We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

About The Team

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager – DGX Enterprise Infrastructure and Cloud-Native Operations
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a world-class Senior Product Manager to architect for the operational future of Enterprise AI. While the NVIDIA DGX is the undisputed "Gold Standard" for AI performance, the enterprise on-premise environment presents an outstanding challenge: How do you make a 1,000-node private cluster feel as fluid, scalable, and invisible as the public cloud? The mission is to deliver the "NVIDIA Experience" within the customer’s data center. In this role, own the software-defined blueprint that transforms raw DGX hardware into a high-availability, self-healing AI Factory!

What You’ll Be Doing

In this role, set the vision for the Enterprise Operational Gold Standard. You will define how the world’s most sophisticated companies deploy, manage, and scale their Enterprise AI Factories.

Productize the On-Prem Lifecycle: Define the "Day 0 through Day 2" experience for DGX SuperPODs. Lead the development of products that handle everything from bare-metal provisioning and network fabric configuration to automated "one-click" firmware rollouts.
Build the "Pit Crew" (Observability): Develop a definitive telemetry and diagnostic suite. When a job slows down in a private data center, your framework should provide the "one-click" answer—isolating a thermal throttle, a degraded InfiniBand rail, or a cabling fault instantly.
Bridge Hardware to Kubernetes: Lead the integration of DGX systems into the cloud-native ecosystem. Ensure that enterprise-grade features like GPU partitioning (MIG), multi-node scaling, and niche scheduling are declarative and seamless.
Standardize at Scale: You aren't just building scripts; but building APIs and Services. Your goal is to eliminate "management snowflakes," ensuring that every enterprise DGX deployment is standardized, repeatable, and resilient.
Drive Predictive Operations: Move the needle from reactive maintenance to self-healing infrastructure. Thoughtfully define the features for automated health checks that keep the fleet at peak performance without manual intervention.

What We Need To See

Enterprise Data Center DNA: 12+ years demonstrated ability in Product Management,,with specific around on-premise infrastructure, private cloud, or large-scale systems management.
Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience.
The "Platform-First" Approach: A track record of turning complex hardware operations into software-defined workflows. You understand that in the enterprise, Product = Hardware + Software + Operations.
Cloud-Native Expertise: Expert-level understanding of Kubernetes operators, container orchestration, and how to translate physical hardware constraints into declarative code.
Operational Scars: You’ve lived through the challenges of managing large-scale Linux fleets in air-gapped or restricted enterprise environments. You know what keeps SREs up at night.
Technical Breadth: Deep familiarity with data center networking (InfiniBand/Ethernet), storage architectures, and the firmware-to-OS handshake.
Leadership & Evolution: This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of multiple engineering fields. As you define the NVIDIA Datacenter Experience, you will be positioned on a direct leadership track, with the explicit expectation to transition into formal people management as the team expands.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Automation Evangelist: You have experience with infrastructure-as-code (Ansible, Terraform, Pulumi) in a bare-metal context.
AIOps Pioneer: You have a vision for using AI to manage AI—applying telemetry and machine learning to predict and prevent infrastructure failures.
The NVIDIA Narrative: You believe the "Gold Standard" isn't just about speed—it's about the reliability and simplicity of the Automated Pit Crew.

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the world's most forward-thinking and hardworking people on our team. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 208,000 USD - 327,750 USD for Level 5, and 240,000 USD - 379,500 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until May 15, 2026.

new_jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity:

Our Financial Services ("FSO") teams have been at the forefront of every event that has reshaped and redefined the financial services industry. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!

We live in a new digital world with exciting new technologies and challenges. Financial institutions are going through a seismic change in their business that also provides significant opportunities through a deep finance, risk and technology transformation. Large institutions in Banking, Insurance and Capital Markets are re-evaluating the way they conduct business and are undergoing strategic initiatives to enhance their operations to better serve their clients and address the high bar set by the regulator.

At EY, we pride ourselves on being a trusted advisor to the key stakeholders in the financial services industry. Our vision and flawless execution have driven a substantial growth in our organization. As a result, we are currently looking to expand our team by bringing on board new leaders with the commitment and drive to help our clients succeed. Due to the tremendous growth of the SAP platform, we need individuals versed in the technology that have relevant experience and a well-rounded skillset based on previous successful implementation lifecycles. This is an opportunity with tremendous growth potential for very motivated individuals that observe a strong work ethic. EY is working hard to turn our clients' SAP platform deployments into end-to-end change enablers that bring the true meaning of digital to bear. Instead of delivering isolated technology solutions, we are passionate about helping our clients develop new business processes which complement and leverage their technology ecosystem, helping them to realize far-reaching organizational benefits.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Senior Manager in our SAP Financial Services practice, you are expected to be a leader across both program delivery and practice development. This role requires a strong focus program sales and delivery along with people leadership. Development of our consulting staff and practice delivery capabilities will be critical aspects of your role.

Skills and attributes for success:

A successful senior manager will be drive Firm development initiatives and manage sub-practice areas. The ability to lead multiple threads of work and teams successfully is critical to your success. You will be a critical member of the leadership team working with our program leads and key subject matter advisors (SMA) to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive solution will be delivered on-time and on-budget to the utmost satisfaction of our clients.

Ideal candidates for this role will have the following skills and attributes:

10+ years of work experience, including 8+ year of system implementation execution including experience with the full system development lifecycle delivery
Experience with leading cross functional programs from 10-20 resources onsite and 30+ offshore / global delivery
Provent track record of sales and delivery of managed revenue in the profession service field including development strategic responses to client requests for proposals
Deep understanding of SAP based transformation and drivers for efficiency leveraging core S/4 capabilities
Experience leading teams through initial program phases including business case development and program support infrastructure stand up
Understanding AI based delivery capabilities and methodologies
A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience at a financial services company or comparable experience working
Exceptional written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills
Strong focus on developing staff through mentoring and coaching
Undergraduate / Graduate degree in computer science, engineering, accounting, finance or a related field
Prior consulting industry experience
Experience with at least one full cycle implementation of your core module
A willingness to work in EY offices averaging 2-3 days per week and travel as needed to client project sites – estimated at 25-30%

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $171,600 to $392,100. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $205,900 to $445,700. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager Database Platform
new_jobs.description:
Salary range is:

$136,885.10 - $200,000.00

This position is bonus and/or commission eligible.

CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi-trillion-dollar insurance economy ,
creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com.

The Role

CCC is looking for a Senior Manager that will lead a team of diversely skilled database engineers who architect, build, and maintain various data technologies for the company. This position is based in Chicago on a hybrid model.

This role is key to mission critical business applications that require 24x7 on-call team rotation, incident management, change management and identifying key process methods for efficient delivery of service.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage/lead a team of 3+ direct reports as well as a team offshore resources
Work closely with vendors to maintain and manage solid working relationships
Act as senior technical resource, prioritize tasks, resolve complex problems, and participate in strategy discussions
Resource management and training of the team
Create and maintain appropriate documentation for data stores, production support and end-users.
Collaborate with Operations and Product Development teams as well as Data Architects to assure adherence to operational objectives.
Approximately 40% team leadership, 30% hands on, 30% operations support
Collaborative with the SRE and DevOps teams to automate deployment and monitoring of the CCC data ecosystem
Leverage AI and grow the data teams usage of it to automate daily tasks
Make recommendations on how to reduce hosting complexity/improve operational agility and efficiency

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or combination of work experience and technical certifications
12+ years of information systems experience in a large enterprise systems environment supporting mission-critical systems and applications
5+ years in a technical team lead role of 5 resources or more - Management skill set and long term operational experience
Excellent problem-solving skills across multiple disciplines
Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new technologies quickly
Experience with complex system integration projects
Experience in managing database upgrades and patch management
Previous experience with managing SOC controls
Solid experience with system monitoring and management software
Previous experience with disaster recovery and recovering complex environments
Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Required Technical Qualifications

8 + years of demonstrated experience in Microsoft SQL server
5+ years’ experience using cloud-based database technologies such as AWS Aurora, AWS RDS, Azure PaaS and Hyperscale,
5+ years' experience in Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud
Experience managing large OLTP databases at scale
Has maintained and monitored hundreds of SQL Server installations

Interview Policy & Privacy Notice:

A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE.

About CCC's Commitment to Employees:

CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion & Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most.

At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success.

CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including:

401K Match
Paid time off
Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus
Comprehensive health insurance
Adoption Assistance
Tuition Reimbursement
Wellness Programs
Stock Purchase Plan options
Employee Resource Groups

For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site.
